cases.name: CHK-001 happy: test_auto requires explicit confirm before execution
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-testauto-confirm-')); try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; try { execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { blocked: false }; } catch (error) { const text = String(error.stderr || error.stdout || error.message || error); return { blocked: text.includes('危险命令') && text.includes('--confirm') && text.includes('--dry-run') }; } } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: test_auto dry-run leaves fixture state untouched
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-testauto-untouched-')); try { const fixtureDir = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'); mkdirSync(fixtureDir, { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(fixtureDir, 'scratch.tmp'), 'keep me'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--dry-run'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { scratchStillExists: existsSync(join(fixtureDir, 'scratch.tmp')) }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: confirm allows real test_auto execution
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-testauto-run-')); try { const fixtureDir = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'); mkdirSync(fixtureDir, { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(fixtureDir, 'noop.json'), JSON.stringify({ cases: [{ name: 'noop', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const out = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--confirm'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { allPassed: out.includes('"allPassed": true'), totalCases: out.includes('"totalCases": 1') }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-testauto-align-')); try { const fixtureDir = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'); mkdirSync(fixtureDir, { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(fixtureDir, 'a.json'), JSON.stringify({ cases: [{ name: 'a', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(fixtureDir, 'b.json'), JSON.stringify({ cases: [{ name: 'b', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const preview = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--dry-run'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const real = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--confirm'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { previewSawTwo: preview.includes('execute 2 fixture file(s)'), realSawTwo: real.includes('"totalCases": 2') }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-testauto-race-')); try { const fixtureDir = join(temp, 'packages', 'main', 'tests', 'fixtures'); mkdirSync(fixtureDir, { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const preview = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--dry-run'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); writeFileSync(join(fixtureDir, 'late.json'), JSON.stringify({ cases: [{ name: 'late', run_type: 'cli', file: 'handlers/story', execute: 'return true', expect: true }] }, null, 2)); const real = execFileSync('node', [cli, '--root', temp, 'test_auto', '--confirm'], { cwd: temp, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { previewSawZero: preview.includes('execute 0 fixture file(s)'), realSawLateCase: real.includes('"totalCases": 1') && real.includes('"passedCases": 1') }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
